title: Stop Uploading PDFs to Claude
description:
Still uploading raw PDFs to Claude?

That can consume a lot of tokens and introduce unnecessary formatting noise.

In this video, I show how MarkItDown, Microsoft's open-source document conversion tool, can convert PDFs and other files into clean Markdown that's often easier for AI models to work with.

Here's what it supports:

• PDFs
• Word documents
• Excel spreadsheets
• PowerPoint presentations
• Web pages and more

You'll learn:

• Why Markdown can be more efficient than raw PDFs for AI workflows
• How to use MarkItDown with Claude
• How to automate document conversion with its MCP server
• Ways to streamline document processing for AI projects

If you use Claude or other AI tools for research, coding, or document analysis, this workflow can make your inputs cleaner and easier to manage.

Check the pinned comment for the MarkItDown guide and setup.
